title: VOOL software – app, portal, billing and roaming
description: What the VOOL platform does: smart charging, load management, users and access, pricing, billing, payouts, public charging and roaming.

sections.title: The charger is half of it. The software does the rest.
sections.lead: One platform for drivers, site owners and installers. Most of it is free. You pay only when VOOL collects money for you.

items.title: Smart charging
items.text: Charges in the cheapest hours, following Nord Pool prices.

items.title: Schedules
items.text: Recurring charging times that match your week.

items.title: Costs and history
items.text: Energy and cost for every session.

items.title: Public charging
items.text: Find VOOL public chargers, see the price and pay in the app.

items.title: Setup for installers
items.text: Commission chargers and LMCs over Bluetooth and hand the site to the owner.

items.title: Free
items.text: For iPhone and Android.

items.title: Sites and devices
items.text: Live status, sessions and energy for every charger and LMC.

items.title: Users and access groups
items.text: Decide who may charge where, with roles for managers.

items.title: RFID cards
items.text: Give residents, employees or drivers a card to start charging.

items.title: Pricing rules
items.text: Different prices for different groups: residents, staff, guests.

items.title: Scheduled reports
items.text: Consumption and cost reports sent to you automatically.

items.title: Any OCPP charger
items.text: Add chargers from other makers over OCPP 1.6 or 2.0.

sections.eyebrow: For sites that charge money · revenue share
sections.title: Billing, public charging and roaming

items.title: Managed billing
items.text: VOOL charges the drivers, issues the invoices and pays you.

items.title: Public charging
items.text: Your charger appears on Google Maps, Waze, Apple Maps and other maps, with ad hoc payment.

items.title: Roaming
items.text: Through Hubject, drivers can use the charging apps and cards of other providers at your public chargers. We are adding providers now.

items.title: Load management
items.text: Dynamic load management and automatic phase switching with VOOL LMC.

items.title: Modbus TCP
items.text: Read values and set limits from a building or energy management system.

items.title: OCPP and OCPI
items.text: Connect chargers to another back end, or connect partner platforms to VOOL.

items.title: 4G connectivity
items.text: Built into chargers and LMCs. From 1 January 2027: €2.50 per month or €24 per year per device, VAT included. New chargers get 30 days free.

items.title: ISO 15118
items.text: Plug & Charge with the new VOOL Charger, V2G by firmware update in Q1 2027.

items.title: DAEI in Lithuania
items.text: Get paid for the electricity you charge.

items.title: Solar and vehicle data
items.text: Charging on your own solar power and reading the car’s battery level. Returning at the end of 2026.

items.title: All integrations
items.text: Protocols, typical setups and technical limits.
